dedupe_keys.name: asam openx simulation standards opendrive road networks and openscenario driving scenarios

description: ASAM publishes the OpenX family of standards for driving and traffic simulation. ASAM OpenDRIVE (version 1.9.0, released 19 May 2026) describes static road networks in XML files with the extension xodr: the geometry of roads and lanes, objects such as road marks, and features along roads such as signals, from synthetic or real data, so that they can be fed into simulations. ASAM OpenSCENARIO XML (version 1.4.0, released 19 May 2026) describes dynamic scenarios, meaning vehicle manoeuvres, in xosc files. Coverage: generic. The ASAM site also lists a quality checker, an OpenX example repository, work on using OpenDRIVE with CityGML, off-road use, and an OpenX ontology. Format and access: XML schemas and file format specifications that can be viewed online and downloaded free of charge. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): ASAM licensing terms (standards are ASAM intellectual property; rights of use granted under the ASAM licence terms). Caveats: the other OpenX standards (OSI, OpenCRG) were not read; ASAM membership is needed to join the projects. Simulation uses: road network and scenario inputs for traffic simulation and automated driving tests, including road digital twins used in network flow studies. Related records: SUMO (platform-sumo) and CARLA (platform-carla) are simulators that read OpenDRIVE networks.
